title: Actual Studio V1 direct Scene submission contract, with profile-specific runtime constraints
description: Read-only audit artifact, not an installed validator. Root shape is the EXISTING direct Studio submission {profile,sceneJson,...}; choose $defs/rawScenePlan for a raw long Scene object. Both profiles share plan.schema WORLD_ENGINE_UNIVERSAL_VIDEO_V2, so the real discriminator is the sibling Studio profile.

prompt.description: Ignored for scene interpretation when sceneJson is supplied; preserved as promptText.

sfx.x-reference: STUDIO_PROMPT_CONTRACT.schema.json owns detailed SFX schema; this artifact audits Scene data only.

x-runtime: LineString validated by existing Event line contract; Polygon/MultiPolygon validated by existing Area geometry contract. Structural JSON Schema is not a geometry-admission certificate.
No coordinate repair, interpolation, invented fronts, or coercion.
PRODUCTION legacy planner rejects SYNTHETIC_TEST or REFERENCE_DISPLAY_VALUE source types and requires VERIFIED. SYNTHETIC_TEST mode requires both source_type and verification_status SYNTHETIC_TEST.

Universal Python _source checks nonempty records and verification_status; it does not independently certify an article body or map accuracy. Native/source binding validators perform separate file SHA verification.
Unknown source fields are retained in long-plan sourceManifest records; legacy fact normalizer selects known fields. A verification_status string alone does not prove archival geometry.

universalSourceRecord.description: Exact minimum Python _source predicate. Compiler-produced public records also contain id/source_type/source_reference and may carry nullable original_body_sha256, accuracy, access and review fields; those additional metadata keys are not independently interpreted by this predicate.

x-runtime: Bound file must decode WORLD_ENGINE_UNIVERSAL_NATIVE_INPUT_V1 with exact five nativeFiles keys regionalPlan,continentPlan,scene,cameraPlan,inputManifest.
Every file SHA, canonical output, FPS, preserved camera LOCK, event anchor, primary country and primary geometry must match existing inputs.
Studio requires READY and current immutable imageDigest through bind_render_image/validate_render_plan; READY never means NVIDIA or visual-quality PASS.
This is an intent/identity descriptor, not arbitrary camera keyframes. Native preparation pins the preserved V5 camera; V4 runtime rejects modifications to the frozen descriptor.
Current historical path selects REFERENCE_V2_SOURCE_WITH_AREA_V3; merely naming a different material profile is not a supported renderer command.
fps equals metadata.output.fps; duration_seconds = total_frames / fps; camera_lock_frame = event_start_frame; blank_interstage_frames = 0.
Supplied FACT_DATA.scene_timing has an exact whitelist; portable scene timing validator permits extra keys but checks invariants.
compileExistingEnginePlan requires supplied graphic; an object role string alone does not create a renderable unit or historical location.
Original Event metric contract remains authoritative for display_value/unit/source acceptance; source must resolve to a supplied source record.
Must supply a LineString geometry_ref or radius_end_degrees > radius_start_degrees; geometry binding selects irregular wave presentation, not physics.

Actual validateScenePlan additionally enforces family-specific categories, known references, uniqueness, exact geometry normalization, chronological states, contiguous half-open beats, final HOLD, Event/Area/Flow contracts and causal track data.
This is an existing standalone portable Planner Scene V1. It is not accepted as a direct Studio sceneJson because Studio expects the long-video wrapper below.
Nested JSON Schema documents known fields; runtime is stricter where specified. Do not treat schema-only PASS as render admission.

workScene.x-units: All frame fields are absolute GLOBAL frame indices; interval is [startFrame,endFrame).
x-runtime: Work scenes are generated by contracts._scene and V3 _work_scenes. These dictionaries are not independent authored control tracks: duplicated fields must exactly equal their regenerated values.

Every scene starts at prior scene end; globalFrameOffset equals startFrame; end > start; sum covers totalFrames; neighboring boundary records equal. SourceManifest SHA and legacyScene SHA are canonical JSON SHA256, not necessarily file byte SHA.

These are normalizeProductionVisualProfile source-profile fields, not accepted Studio free-text or preset overrides. In V3 the whole visual profile is source-file-SHA-bound; in V4 immutable whole-plan equality also applies.
ENTIRE productionV3 object must equal scene_planner._metadata(plan, decoded chronology, ownership, visual, sourceBindings).
sourceBindings must equal sourceManifest.productionSources, contain immutable parentManifest path/hash, and each chronology/ownership/visualProfile file must match SHA.
Geometry clock is monotonic and separate from narrative clock. Crossfades between supplied snapshots are infographic transitions, not observed daily control.
durationSeconds*fps must be EXACT integer totalFrames (Fraction of decimal string), not rounded. Width:height must equal aspectRatio; encoder fps equals plan fps.

This structural contract is weaker than current Studio profile validators. Unknown top-level long-plan fields are not globally rejected by contracts.validate_plan; acceptance does not imply those fields are renderer controls.
Every scene generated binding equals its exact expected value. Plan camera/material fields are mirrored descriptors; no free-form scalar-effect commands exist here.
CurrentStudio UNIVERSAL_V3 performs V3 metadata/source validation and exact regenerated scene equality; it does not expose a free-form prompt-to-plan builder.
A separately generated new-length V3 plan can be supplied if all native/source/timing/format constraints hold. Changing durationSeconds alone fails. No GPU execution is implied.

CurrentStudio V4_ARCHIVAL_80S supplied plan must equal derive_execution_plan(parent_plan(), supplied image digest, installed front profile SHA, installed front manifest SHA) BEFORE image rebinding; then current image digest is rebound and scenes regenerated.

Immutable parent file byte SHA256: 6fb40abd4970c2595877c4bfb469d8ad0d62e552a03651748b8a1c41a993c28b. No camera/material/territory/timeline/Scene control edit is accepted, including unknown extra fields.
V4 is partial approximate front-only archival data; it never infers occupied territory from an open line, creates missing unit positions, or interpolates unobserved historical fronts.
normalize_submission checks finite JSON, max4MiB, max200000 nodes, max64 depth; enclosing submission profile defaults V4_ARCHIVAL_80S.

Direct sceneJson bypasses prompt interpretation but NOT source/image/native/profile validation. Outer durationSeconds must equal inner plan.durationSeconds and Studio format is fixed1080x1920/30fps/9:16.
GPU/source/storage/approval/CSRF/owner/cost admission are separate gates. Schema PASS is never authorization or actual GPU/quality PASS.
